name: market_token_overview
description: Get basic market information for a token or coin, including price, market cap, supply, and liquidity when available. Use token for major assets like BTC or ETH, or use token_address plus chain for on-chain tokens.

token.description: Token symbol, name, or CoinGecko-style asset identifier for major assets. Example: BTC, ETH, Solana.

token_address.description: Contract or mint address for an on-chain token.

chain.description: Chain or network slug for token_address queries, such as ethereum, bsc, base, arbitrum, polygon, avalanche, solana, or bitcoin.

vs_currency.description: Quote fiat currency for price and market metrics. Defaults to usd.
